0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics, 6-2 overall and 1-2 on the road, visit the 3-6 Charlotte Hornets, who have lost five straight, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Boston sits second in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and third in the East, while Charlotte is ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, 2 games back. No games have been played between the teams this season, but Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 victory in Boston on April 7, 2026. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and Payton Pritchard is day-to-day with an eye abrasion and is a game-time decision; for Charlotte, Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) are out, while Dennis Schroder (thigh) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
